# Accessibility test diagnostics must identify the actual component and enabled checks

The current notification manager test watches mutations under .in-app-notification-root, but its watcher message still says Account Hub dialog. Current CTA and close click tests are skipped in automation with a Bug 1921222 timeout note, while show/hide, replacement and keyboard-shortcut tests remain declared. Manual test comment proposal for this file: describe the actual component and the specific check that ran, and keep skip reasons beside the affected task. A reused helper or an accessibility watcher declaration is not evidence that every click path ran in continuous integration. This is a source-derived diagnostic correction proposal, not a tested failure or a review finding already accepted by maintainers.

Scope: notification-test-diagnostics.
